name: Reoon
description: Email verification — validate deliverability with quick or deep (power) checks.

methods.label: Verify Email
methods.description: Verify a single email address. mode 'quick' is instant syntax/MX/disposable checks; mode 'power' does deep SMTP/inbox checks (slower, more accurate). Returns { status, is_deliverable, is_valid_syntax, is_disposable, is_role_account, mx_accepts_mail, ... }.

methods.label: Check Account Balance
methods.description: Get remaining verification credits. Returns account credit balance.
